epics.title: Payment Gateway Integration
epics.description: Complete payment gateway integration to enable credit card payments, subscription management, and payment event notifications

stories.title: As a customer, I want to make credit card payments, so that I can purchase products and services
stories.description: Enable credit card payment functionality through the Stripe payment gateway
acceptance_criteria: The payment form accepts valid credit card information
The payment form rejects invalid credit card information
The payment processing system successfully charges the customer's credit card
The payment processing system handles declined payments and displays an error message

tasks.title: Setup Stripe payment gateway
tasks.description: Configure Stripe API keys and setup payment gateway

tasks.title: Implement payment form validation
tasks.description: Validate credit card information on the client-side and server-side

tasks.title: Integrate payment processing with Stripe API
tasks.description: Use Stripe API to process payments and handle payment events

stories.title: As a customer, I want to manage my subscriptions, so that I can update or cancel my subscription plans
stories.description: Enable subscription management functionality for customers
acceptance_criteria: The subscription UI displays the customer's current subscription plan
The customer can update their subscription plan from the subscription UI
The customer can cancel their subscription plan from the subscription UI
The subscription management system updates the customer's subscription status in real-time

tasks.title: Design and implement subscription UI
tasks.description: Create a user-friendly subscription management interface

tasks.title: Integrate subscription management with Stripe API
tasks.description: Use Stripe API to update and cancel subscriptions

tasks.title: Implement subscription status updates
tasks.description: Update the customer's subscription status in real-time

stories.title: As a system administrator, I want to receive payment event notifications, so that I can monitor payment activity
stories.description: Enable payment event notifications for system administrators
acceptance_criteria: The system sends a notification when a payment is successful
The system sends a notification when a payment is declined
The system sends a notification when a subscription is updated or canceled
The notification system handles multiple payment events simultaneously

tasks.title: Setup webhook for payment event notifications
tasks.description: Configure Stripe webhook to send payment event notifications

tasks.title: Implement payment event notification handling
tasks.description: Handle payment event notifications and send notifications to system administrators

tasks.title: Test payment event notification system
tasks.description: Test the payment event notification system with multiple payment events

stories.title: As a developer, I want to integrate Stripe API with our system, so that I can use Stripe's payment processing functionality
stories.description: Integrate Stripe API with our system for payment processing
acceptance_criteria: The system can successfully authenticate with the Stripe API
The system can retrieve a list of available payment methods from the Stripe API
The system can create a new payment method using the Stripe API
The system can handle Stripe API errors and exceptions

tasks.title: Implement Stripe API authentication
tasks.description: Authenticate with the Stripe API using API keys

tasks.title: Integrate Stripe API payment methods
tasks.description: Retrieve and display available payment methods from the Stripe API

tasks.title: Handle Stripe API errors and exceptions
tasks.description: Handle Stripe API errors and exceptions and display error messages

stories.title: As a system administrator, I want to test the payment processing system, so that I can ensure it is working correctly
stories.description: Test the payment processing system with multiple payment scenarios
acceptance_criteria: The payment processing system handles successful payments correctly
The payment processing system handles declined payments correctly
The payment processing system handles subscription updates and cancellations correctly
The payment processing system handles multiple payment events simultaneously

tasks.title: Create test cases for payment processing scenarios
tasks.description: Create test cases for successful payments, declined payments, subscription updates, and cancellations

tasks.title: Implement automated testing for payment processing
tasks.description: Create automated tests for payment processing scenarios

tasks.title: Test payment processing system with multiple payment events
tasks.description: Test the payment processing system with multiple payment events simultaneously
